The main takeaway from our work is that

a composition for the liquid dosage form of a monoclonal antibody should be developed using the following approach: (1) the selection of the excipient composition based on the physicochemical characteristics of the mAbs, (2) the selection of a suitable stabilizer, (3) the selection of an appropriate container and closure system for the finished dosage form.

a composition of an excipient for a FDF based on mAbs can be developed in a rational way using the following steps: (i) selection of the API concentration, (ii) selection of a buffer system for a FDF and its composition, (iii) selection of a stabilizer for the API in the FDF, (iv) selection of a surfactant, and (v) selection of a preservative and an antioxidant.
